meta.prompt: Show me how the product did this month as an inline dashboard with a toggle between 7, 30 and 90 days that changes every number. Four stat tiles with their change, each period: 7 days: revenue $18.4k (+4.1%), sign-ups 312 (+6.0%), churn 2.9% (-0.2%), active users 13,870 (+1.4%); 30 days: $78.9k (+8.5%), 1,340 (+11.2%), 3.1% (+0.4%), 14,260 (+6.3%); 90 days: $221k (+15.3%), 3,905 (+9.8%), 3.4% (-0.6%), 14,260 (+12.1%). A line chart of revenue over the period, and a bar chart of sign-ups by channel (Organic, Paid, Referral, Social, Email) that adds up to the sign-ups: 7 days 128, 84, 52, 31, 17; 30 days 540, 372, 218, 134, 76; 90 days 1,580, 1,010, 640, 420, 255. Under them a table of the top five plans I can sort by any column, starting with revenue, highest first: Pro 1,340 subs, $38,900, churn 2.1%; Team 412, $24,700, 1.4%; Starter 2,980, $8,900, 5.2%; Business 96, $4,800, 0.9%; Student 640, $1,600, 6.8%.

state range="30 days"
state sort="revenue"
state desc=true

    StatTile "Sign-ups" "vs previous" value:"1,340" delta:"+11.2%" icon:"person_add"
    StatTile "Churn" "vs previous" value:"3.1%" delta:"+0.4%" invert:true icon:"trending_down"
    StatTile "Active users" "vs previous" value:"14,260" delta:"+6.3%" icon:"group"
  ChartCard "Revenue" value:"$78.9k" values:[62,70,66,80,74,88,95] labels:["W1","W2","W3","W4","W5","W6","W7"] kind:"line" delta:"+8.5%"
  ChartCard "Sign-ups by channel" value:"1,340" values:[540,372,218,134,76] labels:["Organic","Paid","Referral","Social","Email"] kind:"bars" delta:"+11.2%"
